description: Ministry of Justice and National Integration - Trust Ordinance (Chapter 87) Order Under Section 114 - Jayaratnam Trust Fund in Yogapuram
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the legal incorporation of a trust under the Trusts Ordinance (Chapter 87). It involves a regulatory action by the Minister of Justice, authorizing the creation of a legal entity ("body corporate") with specific legal powers and capacities. The content focuses on establishing a legal framework for the trust's operations, including its ability to acquire/dispose of property and sue/be sued, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
